title: The badge ladder

members.role: the proof card lands over the world and holds - the claim's evidence arrives before any qualification; the rail lands on an EVEN pill count (2 or 4) where the series allows, to use its width
the first badge stamps onto the card's rail, 2.05 s after it lands
the second badge stamps one clause later, 1.30 s behind the first
the third badge stamps on the next clause, the same 1.30 s beat
the fourth badge stamps the last qualification, still on the 1.30 s beat

dials_source: 41 of 43 Steel docks, every first badge at dock_enter + 2.05 exactly; 40 gaps all exactly 1.30
does: A proof card lands, then its qualifications stamp onto its rail one per clause: the first 2.05 s after the card arrives, every later one 1.30 s behind the last.
